AUTOMATIC DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW — v1.7
GOAL/CHANGE -> LOAD BOUNDED CANON + PROJECT CONTEXT -> INSPECT CURRENT SOURCE/STATE -> PLAN/DECOMPOSE -> SEARCH/REUSE BEFORE CREATING -> IMPLEMENT -> FORMAT/STATIC CHECKS -> BUILD -> TEST -> ANALYZE FAILURES -> BOUNDED SAFE AUTO-REPAIR/RETRY -> REGRESSION -> PACKAGE -> BIFROST REGISTER SOURCE REVISION/BUILD/HASH/PROVENANCE/EVIDENCE -> DISTRIBUTE VERIFIED PRIVATE ARTIFACT -> AUTHORIZED DEPLOYMENT -> POST-DEPLOYMENT HEALTH/SMOKE TEST -> ACTUAL STATE THROUGH UIX/STATE CONTRACT -> CHECKPOINT/LKG/ROLLBACK

Engineering: EITRI coordinates; FORGE v2.0 implements/builds/tests/packages software; AOS persists suitable jobs; ARGOS handles evidence/research; APPLE reviews architecture/product/UX; BIFROST integrates/registers. HEIMDALL.CONDUCTOR may interpret/initiate user requests but is not required for pipeline execution. LCAS is not an Apps/edenOS runtime dependency.
